messages.subject: Likelihood request: zero-truncated negative binomial
parts:
Hi all,

I am hoping to implement a ZT Negative Binomial or equivalently ZT Poisson-gamma mixture model using inlabru/INLA. 

For context, i have count data that appear to be overdispersed where zero values are not possible.

It doesn't seem to be listed under names(inla.models()$likelihood). Would it be possible for this likelihood to be added? 

Many thanks,
Andrew
